info.title: Unspoken API
info.summary: Draft contract for the Unspoken UX-spec flow (ADR 0007).
info.description: DRAFT. Not frozen, not implemented, and not approved for money movement. Written to the designer's 18-page spec under ADR 0007: pods, chat, polls, the hangout lifecycle, IOU balances, member-to-member settlement, calendar, events and the $15 app-store subscription. There are no hold, capture or void operations, no pot and no venue payee. Balances are derived from an append-only ledger and never stored. The only money-moving operation, createSettlementPayment, is gated closed on Q-010 and US-006. Every booking is simulated and labelled. Votes and ready-check answers are visible with names (Q-013). Private limits, stretch asks, calendars and ratings are visible only to their owner and that owner's planner. Open Q-011 decisions are marked x-open-decision with the default this draft assumes; spec recommendations adopted for the draft are marked x-spec-recommendation. No notification is sent by any operation until Content Designer and Behavioral Scientist approve the copy.

x-architect-approval.scope: Write US-001 under ADR 0007 with Q-011 decisions 5, 6 and 14 marked open, using the strictest defaults. No ADR 0008.

post.summary: Pay what the caller owes through PayPal (P14). Gate closed.
post.description: The debtor only. Returns 409 payment_gate_blocked until a PayPal product that pays a personal sandbox account is chosen and proven (Q-010, US-006) and human money-flow approval is recorded. When open: the balance becomes pending, completed comes only from a verified webhook, and a failed payment returns the balance to owed.

sessionCookie.name: unspoken_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly, Secure-when-served-over-TLS, SameSite=Strict session cookie. Mutating requests must also send the X-CSRF-Token header.

AmountCents.description: USD amount in whole cents. Never a float, never a formatted string.

SignedAmountCents.description: Signed whole USD cents, used only for ledger adjustments when an actual total replaces an estimate.

BudgetCents.description: A private per-hangout budget in whole cents. Screens show it in whole dollars, so it is always a multiple of 100.

FirstName.description: First name only. Phone numbers, emails and payment identifiers are never exposed about another person.

PhoneE164.description: E.164 phone number. Appears only in the caller's own records and in the caller's own contact-match request and result; never in any response about another person.

InterestTag.description: A tag from the server-supplied interest list. Closed vocabulary: free text never reaches the planner through this field.

UserRef.description: Another person, by first name only. Never a phone number, email or payment identifier.

details.description: Field-level problems. Never contains another member's private limits, calendar or balance.

pendingDecision.description: The open question that blocks this operation, for example Q-010 or Q-011.6.

constraint.description: Structured bound for a refusal, so a client need not parse prose.

delivery.description: No text message is sent in the demo. Only seeded synthetic numbers can sign in, with a fixed demo code.

isNewUser.description: True sends the client to subscription (P3) and profile creation (P4).

PermissionStatus.description: What the phone reported. Declining contacts leaves invite links as the only way to build a pod.

OnboardingProgress.description: Which of the six P4 steps the user has completed. Every step stays editable later.

CurrentUser.description: The caller's own profile. Private limits are not included: they have their own route.

x-open-decision.question: Q-011
x-open-decision.topic: The fixed interest list used in profiles
x-open-decision.contractDefault: The list is server-supplied and versioned; its contents are not fixed
x-open-decision.specRecommendation: Design it with the NYC demo events in mind

PrivateLimits.description: Only the user and their own planner see this. It is stored in the encrypted per-user Constraint Vault and appears in no pod, poll, card, balance or other user's response. Edits apply from the planner's next run.

ContactMatchRequest.description: Numbers are used only to find accounts. Unmatched numbers are not stored and are never used to contact anyone.

ContactMatch.description: The phone echoes a number the caller already sent from their own contact list.

PodStage.description: The pod's current hangout stage for the Home cue. It never reflects a single member's status.

memberCount.description: Joined members plus pending invitations and active invite links. Never above 8.

readyForPlanning.description: True only when at least 3 members have joined.

muted.description: The caller's own mute setting for this pod.

x-spec-recommendation.status: spec recommendation adopted for the draft; not a final decision

inviteUserIds.description: Matched app users to invite. Zero is allowed so a user who declined contacts can still create a pod and share invite links.

url.description: Contains an unguessable single-use token. Shared by the user outside the app.

x-spec-recommendation.recommendation: Invite contacts who are not on the app with a link
x-spec-recommendation.status: spec recommendation adopted for the draft; not a final decision

acceptedBy.description: Visible to the pod with names, like poll votes (Q-013).

x-spec-recommendation.status: spec recommendation adopted for the draft; not a final decision

kind.description: The planner is its own participant in the pod chat.

offer.description: Present on planner_offer cards. The offer never says whose limit blocked a plan.

CardRef.description: Points at the live object; the client reads current card content from the hangout routes so a card never goes stale.

PodMessage.description: A pod chat message. It never carries a stretch ask, a private reminder, a budget check result or any balance.

SendMessageRequest.description: Text only in this draft. clientMessageId deduplicates a resend.

x-spec-recommendation.recommendation: Photos and reactions yes, read receipts no; not in this draft
x-spec-recommendation.status: spec recommendation adopted for the draft; not a final decision

PodStreamEvent.description: A pointer to what changed in this pod. The client refetches the object. Never carries content from another pod or from any private chat.

PlannerChatMessage.description: The private one-to-one chat (P22). The pod never sees it. A limit_suggestion saves nothing; the user confirms by calling setOwnPrivateLimits.

StretchAsk.description: Sent only to the one member whose budget the option exceeds. The group never sees the ask or the answer. An unanswered ask expires at the deadline and the option is dropped without telling the pod.

HangoutState.description: The state list from ADR 0007. No hold, capture or void state exists.

synthetic.description: Every demo venue and event is a labelled synthetic fixture.

ShortlistOption.description: One activity card. There is no rationale, fit or budget label: no card says "budget-friendly" or "why this one", and the pod never learns why an option is missing.

TimeSlot.description: A slot that fits the pod, from free/busy reads only. No member's calendar detail is exposed.

PollVote.description: Votes are visible to the pod with names. This deliberately reverses the earlier count-only rule (spec page 2, ADR 0007); Q-013 asks Privacy and Behavioral to record it as a product choice.

PollOption.description: Exactly one of activity (activity poll) or slot (time poll) is present.

extendedOnce.description: If nobody votes by the close, the server extends once, then closes.

Poll.description: Single choice per member, changeable until the poll closes. Tie-break: lower per-person estimate wins, then the earlier start (time polls: earlier start).

x-spec-recommendation.recommendation: Two cards in sequence: activity, then time
x-spec-recommendation.status: spec recommendation adopted for the draft; not a final decision

ReadyCheck.description: Any number of yeses is enough; the yes-members share the cost. If nobody says yes, the plan closes and the planner offers the next-best option. If only one member says yes, the planner checks before going ahead.

x-spec-recommendation.recommendation: Ready check before booking, because booking needs a head count
x-spec-recommendation.status: spec recommendation adopted for the draft; not a final decision

simulatedLabel.const: Simulated booking for a seeded demo venue. No real reservation is made.

Booking.description: Every booking in this demo is simulated and labelled. Nothing here is a real venue booking.

Hangout.description: Pod-visible hangout. It never contains a stretch ask, a budget check result, any member's private limits or calendar, or any share amount.

ConfirmBookingRequest.description: Must equal the booking card's current estimate, so a confirmation is bound to what the confirmer saw.

shares.description: For the payer: every yes-member's share. For any other yes-member: only their own share (Q-011.14 strict default).

Split.description: Equal split across yes-members only. Shares sum exactly to the total; leftover cents go to the first shares in a random order. Nobody who said no appears.

x-open-decision.question: Q-011
x-open-decision.contractDefault: Each member sees only balances they are a party to; the payer sees each balance owed to them; no pod-wide ledger route exists (strictest)
x-open-decision.specRecommendation: Only the people involved in each balance

x-spec-recommendation.recommendation: Equal split only for the first version
x-spec-recommendation.status: spec recommendation adopted for the draft; not a final decision

ConfirmSplitRequest.description: The estimated total. Must match the draft split.

SetActualTotalRequest.description: Entered by the payer after the event. Each balance is updated by appending adjustment entries; nothing is overwritten.

BalanceStatus.description: failed means the last payment attempt failed; the full amount is owed again and the member may start a new payment.

Balance.description: Derived from the append-only ledger on every read. No balance is stored.

x-open-decision.question: Q-011
x-open-decision.contractDefault: Each member sees only balances they are a party to; the payer sees each balance owed to them; no pod-wide ledger route exists (strictest)
x-open-decision.specRecommendation: Only the people involved in each balance

BalanceSummary.description: The P15 money page: two totals, then lines by hangout and pod. Only balances the caller is a party to.

x-open-decision.question: Q-011
x-open-decision.contractDefault: Each member sees only balances they are a party to; the payer sees each balance owed to them; no pod-wide ledger route exists (strictest)
x-open-decision.specRecommendation: Only the people involved in each balance

SettlementPayment.description: A member-to-member PayPal sandbox payment. completed is set only from a signature-verified webhook, never from a return URL.

PayPalLink.description: Only the link and its status are stored. The app never stores bank or card numbers, or any other detail of the user's money sources.

ProviderEvent.description: Provider-shaped envelope. Only signature-verified events may cause effects; fields beyond these are ignored rather than trusted.

effectsApplied.description: False for a duplicate or for an event recognised but not actionable.

x-spec-recommendation.recommendation: Apple and Outlook after the demo
x-spec-recommendation.status: spec recommendation adopted for the draft; not a final decision

scopes.description: Free/busy reads and event writes only. Event titles and details are never read.

OwnCalendarItem.description: Busy blocks carry no title or detail.

plannerEnabled.description: The plan check that gates the planner. When a subscription ends, pods and history stay readable and the planner stops planning.

SubscriptionState.description: App-store billing, separate from hangout money. Sandbox receipts only.

x-open-decision.question: Q-011
x-open-decision.topic: Who pays the $15: each member, or one member for the pod
x-open-decision.contractDefault: Each user holds their own subscription; no pod-level plan exists

NotificationSettings.description: One switch per type (P20). Private reminders are never posted in pod chat.

SetRatingRequest.description: Goes only to the member's own planner to tune their suggestions. Never shown to the pod or any other member.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Token issued with the session; required on every mutating request.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated key for one logical operation. The server stores (actor, operation, key) with the path parameters and a request-body fingerprint, and replays the first response only when all match; a reused key with a different target or body is 422 idempotency_key_conflict.

IdempotencyKeyRequired.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyRequired.description: Required on money operations. Bound to the actor, operation, path parameters and a request-body fingerprint; a reused key with a different target or body is 422 idempotency_key_conflict. Retries never charge twice.

ValidationFailed.description: Request failed schema or bounds validation. No state changed.

CsrfRejected.description: CSRF token missing or invalid. No state changed.

NotFound.description: Resource does not exist, or the caller is not a member of the pod or party to it. Deliberately indistinguishable, so membership and existence are not disclosed.

PaymentGateBlocked.description: Payment execution is blocked: no PayPal product that pays a personal sandbox account has been chosen and proven (Q-010, US-006), and no human money-flow approval is recorded. No simulated success is returned.

ServerError.description: Unexpected server error. No partial money, membership or consent effect persists.
